post.description: How to become the person nobody dares to mess with.

body.text: That's it. That's the whole sentence.
You don't owe anyone an explanation on why you're unavailable. The second you start over justifying your decisions, you're basically handing people the rope to argue with you.
Confident people say what they mean and keep it moving.
Here's what happens when someone disrespects you:
Most people panic and immediately respond.
You? You pause. Three full seconds of silence. Watch them squirm. Watch them backtrack. That silence tells them everything you're not shaken, you're not scrambling for words, you're just… unbothered.
And that makes all the difference.

items: Telling people more than they need to know

body.text: The more people know about what you're building, the more they can sabotage it. Move in silence. Let your results make the noise.
Once people see you're not bluffing, they either change or they're gone.
Cutting is the easy half. What you build after is slow and easy to miss. Use the Notice app to voice journal and track your growth.
